The involvement of foreign third parties and sensitive data requires strict adherence to the now-enforceable UU PDP and updated OJK governance rules.

findings.finding: Cross-border sensitive data transfer to Singapore processor lacks verified data protection adequacy documentation.
Incomplete Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for the Malaysian seller as required for high-risk cross-border payments.
Necessity for alignment with the new POJK 30/2025 governance and risk management framework for ITSK.

recommendations.action: Conduct a formal Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) for international data flows to Singapore.
Update APU PPT framework to include specific EDD protocols for onboarding cross-border marketplace merchants.
Implement the governance and risk management structure mandated by POJK 30/2025.

compliance_report.executive_summary: PT E-Commerce Nusantara faces high regulatory risks due to cross-border operational complexities and new 2025-2026 OJK regulations. Immediate attention is required for UU PDP compliance regarding sensitive data transfers and enhanced merchant due diligence under APU PPT rules. Adopting the POJK 30/2025 framework is essential for maintaining regulatory standing.

regulation_monitor.monitor_notes: Regulatory monitoring reveals that OJK has modernized governance standards for ITSK through POJK 30/2025 and enhanced APU PPT reporting in 2025. Additionally, UU ITE (Amended 2024) and UU PDP (2022) are now fully enforceable, significantly impacting cross-border e-commerce and data handling.
